BiblicalUsage: The word names burdensomeness, a heavy weight, and Zechariah uses it once, for Jerusalem: God will make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all people, and all that burden themselves with it shall be cut in pieces.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Jerusalem is a stone no nation can lift, because God has set it in place, and those who try to move it will be cut by it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
